**Project Role :** Quality Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Enables full stack solutions through multi\-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end\-to\-end testing process.
  

**Must have skills :** Micro Focus LoadRunner  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Performance Test Lead, you will lead and manage end\-to\-end performance testing and performance engineering activities across enterprise applications. You will collaborate with business, development, architecture, infrastructure, and QA teams to define performance strategies, ensure applications meet performance SLAs, and drive continuous improvements in system scalability and reliability. The role involves designing real\-world workload models, developing performance test scripts, analyzing system bottlenecks, and providing recommendations to optimize application performance throughout the software delivery lifecycle.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME.
* Collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing sessions to enhance team capabilities.
* Monitor project progress and implement necessary adjustments to meet deadlines.


  

Key Responsibilities:
  

Sound knowledge on performance testing tools LRE and JMeter.  

Ability to design complex scenarios to depict real world user patterns.  

Should be proficient with these protocols Web (HTTP / HTML), Web Services, Tru Client, Citrix, SAP\-GUI, KAFKA, MQ  

Good foundation with Performance engineering concepts including knowledge on monitoring tools Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic. Should be able to configure performance metrics for various monitors and build Dashboards.
  

Good understanding of JVM related concepts  

Should be proficient in SQL queries.  

Understanding of the application functionality and performance requirements along with SLA's defined.  

Identify the test environment, test data and access needs.  

Create profiling, test scripts, test plan, executing, trouble shooting and performance tuning.  

Create monitoring profiles to acquire performance metrics to ensure optimization.  

Analyze test results and call out any discrepancies against the SLAs.  

Publish performance analysis reports and conduct review sessions with all the stakeholders.

* '' Good to have experience in MAWM ( Manhattan Warehouse management) application ''

* Experience with scripting and automation tools to enhance testing efficiency.
* Ability to analyse performance test results and provide actionable insights.

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of hands\-on experience in Micro Focus LoadRunner.

title: WHS Officer
description:
**Description**
 The Site WHS Officer will be responsible for partnering with a site operations team in a Fulfillment Center to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. The Site WHS Officer must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis.
   

  

 The Site WHS Officer must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. This individual must instruct and train Operations Leaders in company safety policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards at their site. The Site WHS Officer will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company safety policies. The Site WHS Officer will be required to possess excellent safety program and relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrates this expertise when working with Operations.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in an environmental Health \& Safety (EHS) related field
* 1\+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs or in work health and safety.
* Flexible to work in rotational shifts basis the business requirement .
* Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience using the Microsoft Office suite

description:
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next\-generation, life\-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

  

The **Clinical Sales** role is responsible for driving Leica Biosystems’ Core Histopathology, Immunohistochemistry (IHC), and Digital Pathology growth through a strong combination of clinical application expertise and direct sales execution. The role will support customers across the assigned territory through technical consultation, product demonstrations, proof\-of\-principle activities, customer training, troubleshooting, and scientific engagement, while also carrying sales targets and contributing directly to opportunity creation, funnel progression, revenue conversion, and market share expansion.

  

This position reports to the **Regional Manager, West** and is part of the Sales/Commercial organization located in **Mumbai, India** and will be fully remote to cover the Maharashtra and Goa.

 **In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Provide clinical application expertise across Core Histopathology, IHC, Digital Pathology, IVD, and RUO portfolios through customer training, troubleshooting, technical consultation, workflow optimization, and scientific discussions with pathologists, laboratory professionals, researchers, and key opinion leaders.
* Drive pre\-sales and post\-sales customer engagement by planning and executing product demonstrations, workshops, scientific meetings, academic programs, exhibitions, customer education initiatives, and Proof of Principle activities including evaluations, sampling programs, and customer validations.
* Carry and deliver assigned sales targets by identifying, creating, qualifying, and converting opportunities through direct customer engagement, while supporting business objectives, revenue growth, market share expansion, and customer adoption.
* Build and maintain a robust sales funnel, ensure accurate CRM opportunity tracking, prepare monthly activity reports, and document customer interactions, application support activities, follow\-up actions, and business outcomes.
* Collaborate closely with sales, marketing, channel partners, regional and global application teams, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues, gather market and competitive intelligence, strengthen customer relationships, and support strategic business decisions.

 **The essential requirements of the job include****:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pathology, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in Histopathology, Immunohistochemistry, Pathology Applications, Clinical Diagnostics, Diagnostic Sales, or Technical Sales.
* Demonstrated knowledge of pathology workflows, antibody\-based assays, immunohistochemistry, companion diagnostic applications, and related cancer diagnostics workflows.
* Proficiency in customer\-facing application support, product demonstrations, technical troubleshooting, customer training, opportunity tracking, Microsoft Office applications, and CRM tools.
* Ability to travel 60–80% within the assigned territory and other geographies as business needs require.

 **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Experience working with pathology laboratories, cancer diagnostics, immunohistochemistry reagents, companion diagnostics, or primary antibodies.
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing application specialist, product specialist, clinical sales specialist, technical sales, or diagnostic sales role.
* Exposure to distributor/channel partner management, territory development, market intelligence, and competitive analysis.
